## Summary / Tóm tắt

> 🌐 Language / Ngôn ngữ: **English** | [Tiếng Việt](PULL_REQUEST_TEMPLATE.vi.md)

Describe the problem, the change, and why it is needed.

## Validation / Kiểm thử

- [ ] Focused automated tests passed
- [ ] Full relevant CI checks passed
- [ ] English/Vietnamese docs updated together
- [ ] No secrets or personal data included
- [ ] Deployment, migrations and rollback impact documented

## Evidence

List source commit, relevant commands and sanitized outputs. Do not claim human acceptance unless it occurred.
